description_en: Creates a custom response code rule for a site
description_zh: 新增站点的修改响应码配置
name: CreateCustomResponseCodeRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version on which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The rule content. Conditional expressions are used to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq "video.example.com")
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en: The execution order of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence
